{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Convert revenue from string to float, removing commas
# Use .str.replace to remove commas and then .astype(float)
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for the 6 internal QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
daemon_orders = df[df['revenue'] == 999999.99]
print(f'Number of QA orders: {len(daemon_orders)}')

df.head()"}
